bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 172, Number 142 (Tuesday, September 8, 2026)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. SUBRAMANYAM:
H.R. 10322.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I Section VIII of the Constitution gives Congress
the authority to write legislation
[Page H5520]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
